open: Gameweek six. Two derbies, a league leader under investigation, and a man on zero points who still leads his derby. Here's how it lines up.

beats: Kobbie Mainoo Fan. Top of the table, unbeaten in four, and under investigation. Baha has gone full Man City.
Hall scored thirteen last week. Isak is carrying a knock, which at this point is less an injury update than a personality trait.
Trophy Hunters. Bryant has won three straight, the best form in the league. The name was a joke in August.
Semenyo, Tzolis and Brobbey scored thirty-six between them last week. All three now carry knocks. Turns out carrying Bryant is a contact sport.
Baha leads the series five to two. Bryant's best form of the season meets Baha's oldest habit: beating Bryant.
Cold Palmers. Parker says he's winning Manager of the Month. The model says nine percent. The model has never kicked a ball.
Palmer, Mainoo, Rice and Jacquet all carry knocks. Bad week to have named your club after one of them.
Devils U21s. Five games, five defeats, zero points, and PJ still leads this derby four to three. Form is temporary. Owning Parker is permanent.
Gibbs-White tops the eleven. Not a single flag among PJ's starters. Fully fit. Just shite.
Parker is only a narrow favourite against a side on zero points. Read that again.
I Am a Baleba. Ethan put fifty-four on PJ last week, his best of the season. Ethan, everyone has a career high against PJ.
Haaland goes to Anfield. Ethan's plan is Haaland. Ethan's backup plan is also Haaland.
The Soaring Gulls. Two hundred and forty points, the most in the league, and still not top. All process, no parade.
Gabriel heads the eleven, at home to Leeds. A centre-back leading the line off corners. CJ has basically become Arsenal.
Ethan leads the series four to three. The model still backs CJ. It's seen Ethan's transfers.
In It to McGinn It. Nate lost by a point, then by twenty-six. Somehow he made the one-point defeat the good week.
Fernandes leads the eleven, at home to Spurs. Porro and Rashford are seventy-five percent, which for Rashford is above his usual effort level.
Team Jacob. Lost by four, then by one. At this rate, he wins by two on Saturday.
Saka leads the eleven, at home to Leeds. Mbeumo hosts Spurs as well, so United and Tottenham decide something important. Imagine.
First ever meeting, and the model makes Jacob a clear favourite. Nate, you've been underestimated before. Correctly, but still.

close: That's the gameweek. Lineups in before Saturday's deadline, and get yourself on the record, so we know who to laugh at on Monday.
